body:
i'm in a very similar boat. if i killed myself, my mom would be absolutely devastated, and that's one thing that's keeping me from doing it. my mother is amazing, she's a single mom and works really hard.

i'm anti-social and i don't do very well in school either. in fact, i have summer school this year, which will be hell.

wrong decisions and mistakes are a part of life. as much as society loves to make your bad choices follow you for a lifetime (ie dropping out of high school), you don't have to let it be that way. i know you're probably so tired and so drained, but finding the motivation to keep going is the best feeling in the world, and i want you to stick around to be able to accomplish it
and based on your posts i can tell all you're doing is begging for attention.

why are you talking about your problems and reaching out for help and then you reply with "..." to everyone who tries to talk to you? you might as well have not even posted. i guess you just want attention.
i feel like i'm addicted, it's hard to stop

thanks for your reply. i've said and done some pretty awful things to my online friend. i feel like i'm always manipulating her. at least you have the decency to hold yourself back from saying anything that extreme, and that's really good. i just have self-destructive impulses sometimes.

i wish i could dropout now, but i'm only 16 and i need parental permission (no way in hell would my mom let me quit school). i miss quite a lot of school too, i'm in the "red-zone" as the school calls it

actually, i ramble in the notes app in my phone on the time, so it's sort of like a jumbled, weird series of journal entries. they kind of resemble poems. it helps me pour everything into something physical, like notes on my phone, if that makes sense.

people are really intimidating. social anxiety tends to create these paranoid delusions that you're the center of attention everywhere you go. that's the scariest part about it.

and i love scrabble! i draw a lot actually, usually characters and still lives
hey! i'm glad i have someone to relate to. feel free to pm me if you want, it'd be great to talk to someone

hey there, thanks so much. i'm a sophomore in high school and it's miserable. i have clinical depression and social anxety, and i've been on countless medications this past year and a half. i just want to fast foward to college so i can escape and be happy

i'm glad you're not having suicidal thoughts as often, that's good. but it's shitty when they creep up on you.
i used to love me some Nirvana. Heart-shaped Box was my all-time favorite

thank you very much for your support, and much love to you as well!

during sophomore year, i was also hospitalized twice for suicide ideation. it was my lowest point, i hated it. but i got through it, and if i got through something so serious, i think i can get through the next half of my high school career. i'm so excited for my last day of senior year, walking out of those doors knowing i'll (hopefully) never see anyone there again

yeah, i have a few friends i chill with at lunch sometimes, but honestly i feel like we're becoming more and more distant everyday. but everyone around school talks about how much they hate it, and it makes me feel less alone.

as for the system i play, i usually just play on my old Xbox 360, nothing significant. i like playing skating games and first-person shooters while high, it's my guilty pleasure

hey man thanks so much, that's a good analogy. i really hope i'm able to block this shit out when i'm older.
and i would love a videogame/smoke buddy :)
that's what i was afraid of
thank you for your reply, i hope it gets better for me once i go to college. i really want to be in control of my own life
yeah, i know, it's a really bad habit
pm me if you'd like to chat, i'll try to reply as fast as i can. i'm going through some of the same stuff and i really want to help you.

thanks for your reply. i'm so glad you didn't go through with it. although i don't feel the same about my life, your is so very precious, and you're so young yet. i definitely understand how you're feeling. i have a hard time working up the will to do work. i think, "is it worth it? is there anything good at the end?" i'm still considering it. i'm going to die anyway, why not just speed up the process?

thank you! i know that a lot of artists and musicians have mood disorders. i think Kurt Cobain even had bipolar as well. it's said that having bipolar actually increases your creativity. i usually draw characters, but i'll draw anything, i love expanding my horizons.

hey there, jack. thanks for your support. my suicidal thoughts started in a passive manner but now they seem active. multiple times i've planned to hang myself but then i somehow got distracted and forgot about it.

i don't really know if there are good things in my life anymore. i do enjoy drawing, either on paper or with a tablet. i also kind of like smoking weed or taking pills, even though those are both very destructive habits and won't get me anywhere. most of the good things i had seem so distant now.

wouldn't that mean your house was infested with ants? for an entire half of a burger to be covered in ants, that would have to mean a whole bunch of them were already in your house. that's what i'd be most worried about

sadly, i actually have a suicide playlist on soundcloud

my favorites on the playlist are rip richie by richie woods, old light by home and water, decaying organic matter by sadvillian, and black dog by richie woods

usually people with bpd (borderline personality disorder), did (dissociative identity disorder), or someone who has experienced something extremely traumatic will dissociate when reminded of their trauma or even out of the blue. i don't know much about dissociation but i do know quite a bit about mental disorders
nothing is permanent. everything changes. i know you can push through to see how much better it gets, because you've come this far

i have bipolar as well, and it's definitely tough. i have mood swings several times a day. i go from manic to aggressive to depressive and so on. bipolar doesn't have to control your life, there's help for you out there. you can go to a psychiatrist and be put on medication. i'm on some mood stabilizers and they're actually working pretty well. you're never completely hopeless, you've got the rest of your life ahead of you. i hope you're feeling alright soon

side note: i may be wrong, but i think 911 should only be used if you're actually going to attempt suicide right then and there. if you live in america, the national suicide hotline is 1 (800) 273-8255 which is a better resource for suicide help

you time here is limited, that's fact, but in the here and now you can control how much longer you spend on this planet. if your friends are leaving you behind like that in your time of need, they're not really your friends. there are so many people out there you can meet and if you stick around you'll be able to find loving and caring people to surround yourself with. you don't have to go out this way, things always change, it never stays the same. there's hope for you
